summary: Broad risk-on open (S&P up about 1.3-1.8%, Dow up 500-800 points) as oil slides on Iran peace hopes; AI names ex-Nvidia lead while Nvidia trims its 8% opening drop. Since the morning list, AMD, Amazon and Meta reached or neared first targets so levels were raised, NRG was swapped for Eli Lilly (Jefferies street-high target), and Nvidia/DraftKings put confidence was cut; quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news reports.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Up about 5% after JPMorgan kept it on its focus list (AWS growth above 40%); cleared $270, a hold above it targets $280.

picks.name: Meta Platforms
picks.reason: Up about 5% on its JPMorgan focus-list add; morning target hit, now testing the 644.54 intraday high.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 8% on the Oppenheimer upgrade ($600 target) and the Google Cloud deal, past the morning target; $500 and the opening high are the next trigger.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5.7% on the board probe of CEO Huang, but it bounced from an 8% opening drop; a loss of the opening low near $171.50 resumes the slide.

picks.name: Eli Lilly
picks.reason: Up about 2% after Jefferies set a street-high $1,700 target on ex-US obesity-drug demand; a break of $1,400 extends it.

picks.name: DraftKings
picks.reason: Triple downgrade (UBS, Stifel, JPMorgan) after Friday's 21% guidance-cut drop, though the risk-on tape is limiting follow-through.
